entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to update UE configuration parameters, request registration procedure, deliver UAV authorization, or update PEIPS assistance information. Requires established 5GMM context and 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to initiate configuration update procedure.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF to confirm configuration update completion.

entities.name: T3555
entities.description: Timer started when CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND is sent, stopped when CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE is received.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: UE state where NAS signalling connection is established.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: UE state where NAS signalling connection is not established.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: Container IE for service-level authentication and authorization parameters.

entities.name: UE has established 5GMM context
entities.description: Precondition for initiating generic UE configuration update procedure.

entities.name: Assign new 5G-GUTI
entities.description: Network behavior to assign new 5G-GUTI after successful service request procedure.

relations.description: Procedure initiated by CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message.
Procedure completed by CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND starts timer T3555.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE stops timer T3555.
Procedure requires UE to have established 5GMM context.
Procedure can only be used when UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND may contain Service-level-AA container IE.
Condition enables network to assign new 5G-GUTI.
